children: Generation Income Properties amended its secured promissory note with Brown Family Enterprises to extend the maturity by one year. Effective Oct 14, 2026, the note will now mature on Oct 14, 2027 and continues to bear 9% simple interest, payable monthly. The parties acknowledged a $300,000 principal payment on Jul 6, 2026, leaving $5.2 million outstanding as of Sep 28, 2026. The note remains secured by Operating Partnership assets, with no capitalization of accrued interest and no events of default reported.
: Extend maturity and maintain financing flexibility
